sloka: कुम्भकर्णस्ततो यत्तो नित्यं धर्मपथे स्थितः ।तताप ग्रीष्मकाले तु पञ्चाग्नीन्परितः स्थितः ।। ७.१०.३ ॥
transliteration: kumbhakarṇastato yatto nityaṁ dharmapathe sthitaḥ ।tatāpa grīṣmakāle tu pañcāgnīnparitaḥ sthitaḥ ।। 7.10.3 ॥

translations.english: Then, Kumbhakarna, always diligent and situated on the path of righteousness, performed penance by standing amidst five fires during the summer season.
